name: papgi
description: papgi: a PDF editor that runs in the browser (MuPDF + WebAssembly)

scripts.samples: cd samples/src && pdflatex -interaction=batchmode paper.tex && pdflatex -interaction=batchmode paper.tex && cp paper.pdf ../../public/samples/ && python3 make_samples.py && node make_scan.mjs && python3 make_scan.py && rm -f paper.aux paper.log paper.pdf scan_raw.png scan.jpg
